Thanks for the review. I moved the try-stream / fallback logic into a single `_stream_or_fallback` helper, so each provider now only defines its non-streaming call, and I applied the docstring suggestion (d161e0b).

Pushed 6ffb90e to fix the typecheck failure: the Gemini non-streaming fallback returned `response.text`, which can be `None`, so it now returns an empty string in that case. @Light2Dark the refactor and the simpler docstring are in d161e0b, could you take another look when you have a moment?
🚀 Development release published. You may be able to view the changes at https://marimo.app?v=0.25.3-dev15
